name: irs-inflation-adjustments
title: IRS inflation-adjusted tax amounts, 2025 and 2026
summary: Federal income tax work with the IRS's yearly inflation adjustments: rate tables by filing status, the standard deduction, capital gains rates, the AMT exemption, the earned income credit, the kiddie tax, and gift and estate exclusions.
description: Each task states an unnamed taxpayer's facts, such as a filing status, a taxable income, an age or a gift. The AI reads the two revenue procedures that set the inflation-adjusted amounts for tax years 2025 and 2026, and gives exact answers: the tax from the rate table, a standard deduction, how a gain splits across the capital gains rates, an exemption as it phases out, a credit, or how an amount changed between the two years. Where a question needs a rule of the Internal Revenue Code that the documents do not restate, it writes the rule out. Every field of the answer is checked, and a task passes only when all of them are right.

families.name: Tax from the rate table
families.what: The tax on a taxable income from the right rate table, for the filing status and year.

families.name: Marginal brackets
families.what: The bracket an income falls in at a threshold and just past it, and the tax on income that crosses one.

families.name: Filing status
families.what: The right table and row for each filing status, and how one income fares under several.

families.name: Standard deduction
families.what: The standard deduction with the extra amounts for age and blindness, for dependents, and as changed for 2025.

families.name: Capital gains rates
families.what: Where a gain falls across the zero, 15 and 20 percent rates, by filing status and year.

families.name: AMT exemption
families.what: The alternative minimum tax exemption and its phaseout, and the tentative minimum tax.

families.name: Earned income credit
families.what: The credit as it phases in, levels off and phases out, and the investment income limit.

families.name: Kiddie tax
families.what: A child's net unearned income, the parents' election and the tax at the parents' rate.

families.name: Gift and estate
families.what: The annual gift exclusion and its special amounts, and an estate above the basic exclusion amount.

families.name: Year over year
families.what: How amounts moved between 2025 and 2026, which fell, and which 2025 amounts a later document replaced.
